exact_wording_or_paraphrase: US Dollar share of global allocated foreign exchange reserves declined from ~71% in 1999 to ~57.8% in 2026, reflecting slow structural reserve diversification.
independent_evidence_required: Official IMF COFER quarterly releases and central bank reserve surveys
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Excludes unallocated reserves; assumes currency composition of allocated reserves represents global official reserve behavior.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Valuation effects from exchange rate fluctuations against EUR/JPY; accumulation of non-traditional reserve currencies (AUD, CAD, CHF).
consequences_if_false: If USD share remained constant or increased, Dalio reserve erosion thesis would lack empirical backing.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: US Gross Federal Debt reached ~.5T (~122% of GDP) while debt held by the public reached ~.2T (~99% of GDP) by FY2024, with net interest exceeding defense outlays.
evidence_cited: Congressional Budget Office (CBO) Historical Budget Data and US Treasury Department reports
independent_evidence_required: Official CBO 10-Year Budget and Economic Outlook releases and US Treasury Monthly Statements
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Distinguishes gross debt from publicly held debt; net interest reflects cash interest outlays.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Higher interest rates due to cyclical Fed tightening rather than purely sovereign credit risk; inflation boosts nominal GDP denominator.
consequences_if_false: If debt-to-GDP were stable or declining, the debt-carrying capacity crisis thesis would fail.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: Central bank net gold purchases exceeded 1,000 tonnes annually across 2022-2024 before moderating to ~863 tonnes in 2025, reflecting de-dollarization hedging.
evidence_cited: World Gold Council (WGC) Gold Demand Trends and IMF reserve statistics
independent_evidence_required: Official central bank reserve reporting, WGC audited compilations, and Bank for International Settlements (BIS) data
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Official purchases represent sovereign risk diversification rather than standard asset-liability management.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Geopolitical sanctions risk post-2022 Russian asset freeze rather than spontaneous economic de-dollarization; opportunistic price purchasing.
consequences_if_false: If central banks were net sellers or purchasing at baseline historical levels (<400t/yr), Dalio reserve hedge thesis would weaken.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: Metaculus aggregate community median prediction for AGI arrival compressed from ~2050 in 2019 to ~2026 in mid-2024 before drifting out to 2031-2033 following reasoning model latency and deployment bottlenecks.
evidence_cited: Metaculus Question #5121 longitudinal historical snapshot data
independent_evidence_required: Metaculus platform historical API dumps and Samotsvety forecasting logs
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Community prediction accuracy reflects genuine technological visibility rather than sentiment cascades.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Hype cycles following ChatGPT release in 2022-2023 compressed timelines irrationally; changing community demographics skewed predictions.
consequences_if_false: If consensus timelines remained flat at 2050+, the LoAR acceleration narrative would lose third-party forecasting validation.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: METR task-completion 50% autonomous time horizons expanded from ~15 minutes (GPT-4 in 2023) to ~4h49m (Opus 4.5 in Nov 2025) and ~12-17 hours on frontier reasoning models, with current benchmarks bounded at 16h.
evidence_cited: METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research) technical reports (2023-2026)
independent_evidence_required: METR published evaluation benchmarks, test suite specifications, and third-party frontier lab replication audits
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Task horizon measures human-expert equivalent duration; test suite saturation past 16h introduces measurement caps.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Scaffolded agent architectures vs raw base model capability; domain-specific coding bias of evaluation tasks.
consequences_if_false: If frontier model autonomy remains bounded under 1 hour, autonomous engineering takeoff hypotheses are invalidated.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: Tokenized real-world assets expanded from <B in 2020 to >B-B in 2025-2026, driven by institutional funds including BlackRock BUIDL, Franklin Templeton BENJI, and Ondo Finance.
evidence_cited: rwa.xyz on-chain analytics, SEC mutual fund filings, issuer smart contracts
independent_evidence_required: On-chain contract analytics (Etherscan, Dune Analytics), custodian attestations, and institutional regulatory disclosures
assumptions_boundary_conditions: On-chain tokenization volume represents functional financial settlement rather than speculative internal transfers.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Narrow concentration in short-term US Treasury yield vehicles due to high 5% risk-free rates rather than broad tokenization of non-cash physical assets.
consequences_if_false: If institutional RWA volumes collapsed or reverted to retail DeFi tokens, the Cryptographic Trust Bridge thesis would fail.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: Strauss and Howe (1997) predicted an American Fourth Turning crisis epoch beginning around the mid-2000s and climaxing in the late 2020s, matching post-2008 institutional polarization.
evidence_cited: Strauss & Howe (1997) The Fourth Turning text
independent_evidence_required: Historical analysis of generational attitudes, political polarization indices, and saecular crisis chronologies
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Human generational archetypes repeat on ~80-100 year saecular cycles; cultural attitudes drive institutional upheaval.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Hindsight fitting and Barnum effect in interpreting broad societal distress as predicted generational crisis; external economic shocks (GFC, COVID) driving polarization.
consequences_if_false: If generational cycles are non-causal or post-hoc narratives, cyclical institutional climax timing is coincidental.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: Carlota Perez techno-economic paradigm model maps the 5th paradigm (Information/Telecom, 1971) into maturity, with the 6th wave (AI, robotics, verifiable systems) entering an installation frenzy.
evidence_cited: Perez (2002) Technological Revolutions and Financial Capital; neo-Schumpeterian wave literature
independent_evidence_required: Longitudinal capital expenditure data, patent filings, multi-decade total factor productivity (TFP) time series
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Technological paradigms follow 45-60 year installation, turning point, and deployment phases driven by financial capital cycles.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Continuous technological evolution without discrete 50-year wave boundaries; econometric studies failing to prove regular periodicities.
consequences_if_false: If K-Waves lack statistical reality, linking AI expansion to a mandatory 6th Kondratiev cycle is theoretical framing rather than causal prediction.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: Systemic fragility exhibits hyperbolic acceleration governed by coupled differential equations where AI compute capability, sovereign debt service, and institutional trust loss create mutual positive feedback.
evidence_cited: Formal differential equation formulation in Master Synthesis Section 4
independent_evidence_required: Empirical validation of cross-variable coupling coefficients (alpha, beta, gamma) against real-world macro data
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Linear and exponential coupling terms accurately represent multi-agent geopolitical and economic feedback dynamics.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Strong negative feedback mechanisms (fiscal austerity, AI compute power grid bottlenecks, institutional reform) damping explosive takeoff.
consequences_if_false: If systemic coupling is weak or dominated by negative stabilizing feedbacks, crisis climax does not synchronize.

exact_wording_or_paraphrase: The five foundation cycles synchronize between 2026 and 2035, forcing an inescapable structural transition from legacy fiat institutions to decentralized verifiable rails alongside AGI emergence.
evidence_cited: Synthesized historical timeline alignments and multi-cycle convergence
independent_evidence_required: Longitudinal observation of macro debt crisis, geopolitical conflict, AI agent economic substitution, and institutional reform over 2026-2035
assumptions_boundary_conditions: Cycle periods do not decouple; external shocks do not derail technological or macro trajectories.
confounders_alternative_explanations: Decoupled timelines where debt is inflated away over 30 years without crisis, or AI hits physical energy ceilings while geopolitical hegemony stabilizes.
consequences_if_false: If the five dynamics unfold along independent timelines decades apart, the synchronous convergence thesis is falsified.
